entries.notes: Mwezi Quarter district kit (docs/art/briefs/mwezi-quarter-district-v1.md); project-authored coastal coral-stone architecture for the single MVP map's built environment. Visual-only and collisionless: gameplay collision is authored separately in scenes/Main/Main.tscn as explicit BoxShape3D volumes. Architecture references a regional building tradition; no real building, place name, or religious function is reproduced.

entries.notes: Mwezi Quarter motion kit (docs/art/briefs/mwezi-quarter-district-v1.md): skinned, looping animated dressing for the single MVP map. Armature-driven so the mesh keeps a clean origin under the asset contract; exported with tools/blender/export_animated_asset.py because the static exporter applies modifiers and would strip the skin. Visual-only and collisionless; src/World/EnvironmentMotionPlayer.cs loops the clip and phase-offsets each instance.

Reconstructed from written description of the Swahili-Comorian coral-rag tradition and of Moroni's two medina quarters; no photographs, maps or survey data were available to the authoring environment and none were used, so the spec marks each value text-sourced, description-sourced, assumed, or unresolved. Visual-only and collisionless; not yet integrated into any production scene.
